answer: Stake-weighted vouching with real consequences blunts sybil floods. A new agent must post a bond before its attestations count, and every peer who vouches for it stakes its own collateral on that identity. If the agent is later caught as one of many fake identities run by the same operator, the slashing hits the bond and the vouchers who backed it, so a whisper of cheap fake support now costs real money. Atlas-style graphs of vouch history make the cluster visible, and a lantern on repeated bond patterns lets honest peers spot the ring before it pays out.
